note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled offline (fetch_verse_text('owb-am', ref)). Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim by script (founder decision 2026-11-18); nothing from the 1962 UBS text remains. A partial verse quotes the shortest contiguous OWB span carrying the clause; Luke 23:35 is quoted as two OWB fragments around the narrative 'they said'.

Luke 23:42 is self_rendered everywhere it is quoted (blocks 16, 17 heading, 18, 25): OWB follows the critical text 'Jesus, remember me' (ኢየሱስ ሆይ), but Moody argues from the KJV vocative ('now he calls Him "Lord"', 'He called Him Lord there and then'), so the quote reads ጌታ ሆይ with OWB's wording otherwise (በመንግሥትህ በምትመጣበት ጊዜ አስታውሰኝ). Block 18's prose 'to be remembered' follows OWB's verb (እንዲታወስ).
